title: Monotonic Array
description:
An array is monotonic if it is either non-decreasing or non-increasing. Given an array nums, return true if it is monotonic.

Example 1:
Input: nums = [1,2,2,3]
Output: true

Example 2:
Input: nums = [6,5,4,4]
Output: true

Example 3:
Input: nums = [1,3,2]
Output: false

Constraints:
- 1 ≤ len(nums) ≤ 10^5
- -10^5 ≤ nums[i] ≤ 10^5
idea: One pass: record whether an increase (asc) and a decrease (desc) were seen. If both appear, the array is not monotonic.
